description: Add and/or remove tags across up to 300 heartbeats in one call, all or nothing: each heartbeat ends with (its tags | add) - remove. Use it to retag many jobs; for monitors use bulk_update_monitor_tags, to replace one heartbeat's whole tag list use update_heartbeat, to rename or drop a tag everywhere (monitors too) use rename_tag or delete_tag. Requires a key with the write scope. At least one of add or remove is required, and they must not share a tag (422). A heartbeat that would end with more than 10 tags rejects the whole call (422). Each tag is trimmed, lowercased and deduplicated on write, at most 50 characters of a-z, 0-9 and : _ . / -, starting with a letter or digit. Reuse names from list_tags rather than inventing near-duplicates. Returns heartbeats_updated. Calls are limited to 10 per minute, shared by bulk_update_monitor_tags and bulk_update_heartbeat_tags, per calling address for an API key, per user for an app connection (never per key or organization); past that it is a 429 with the seconds to wait. Example: {"heartbeat_ids": ["<id from list_heartbeats>", "<id from list_heartbeats>"], "add": ["team:data"], "remove": ["team:ops"]}

add.description: Tags to add to every listed heartbeat, up to 10.

heartbeat_ids.description: 1 to 300 distinct heartbeat uuids from list_heartbeats. A repeated id is a 422; an unknown id rejects the whole call with a 404 naming every id not found.

remove.description: Tags to remove from every listed heartbeat, up to 10.

name: bulk_update_heartbeat_tags
title: Retag several heartbeats at once
